maneuvers.name: Basic Attack
maneuvers.description: Attack with any Profile. Strike against the target's Dodge; on a win, Wound less their Soak Value.

maneuvers.name: Defend
maneuvers.description: Actively defend yourself against dangerous attacks. Played in response to an Attacking Maneuver; the effect chosen sets the Ki cost.

maneuvers.name: Jump
maneuvers.description: Placeholder maneuver, used to exercise the action economy.

maneuvers.name: Crouch
maneuvers.description: Placeholder Instant maneuver, used to exercise responses.

maneuvers.name: Thumb War
maneuvers.description: Placeholder maneuver: a Skill Clash of Bluff against one target.

maneuvers.name: Surge
maneuvers.description: Gather yourself and recover: take either a Healing Surge or a Ki Surge.
